threat_event: Attacker compromises the cardholder data environment and steals card data at scale (payment page skimming, memory scraping, or theft of clearing files)
threat_source: Organized cybercriminal group focused on payment card theft
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Very large volume of PAN; CDE spans two clouds and two data centers; open gaps in MFT monitoring, segmentation, and partner-hosted payment fields (R-003, R-010, R-025)
regulatory_driver: PCI DSS 12.10.1; 16 CFR 314.4(j); C-FINANCIAL-R05 (500.17(a)); SEC Form 8-K Item 1.05
existing_controls: PAN encrypted at rest with HSM keys; tokenization; 24x7 Cyber Fusion Center; tamper-detection on core payment pages; annual ROC
treatment_plan: Close MFT monitoring gap (POAM-009), segmentation path (POAM-003), and partner payment field coverage (POAM-021); full tabletop with the disclosure committee 2026-11-12 (POAM-005)
key_risk_indicator: Open High CDE findings; days since last tamper-detection gap; PAN discovery hits outside the CDE

threat_event: Ransomware encrypts the settlement platform and delays merchant funding files past the sponsor banks' cutoffs
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 12 unsupported midrange servers; settlement recovery took 9.5 h against a 6 h RTO; mainframe operators on password-only sign-in since 2026-02; plain-text scheduler credentials until 2026-08

existing_controls: EDR on midrange servers; immutable backups and virtual tape in DC-2; PAM for administrators; annual DR test
treatment_plan: Replace unsupported servers (POAM-001); vault all batch credentials (POAM-002); restore operator MFA (POAM-004); automate scheduler recovery and retest with a sponsor bank (POAM-006)
owner: Senior Vice President, Core Payment Platforms
key_risk_indicator: Settlement DR test duration against RTO; unsupported servers remaining; operators without MFA

threat_event: Attacker exploits a zero-day vulnerability in the managed file transfer appliances and takes clearing and funding files

key_risk_indicator: MFT patch latency; unexplained MFT outbound connections
